title: Better-Auth Trusted Origins Reflection Allows Arbitrary Cross-Origin Requests (CSRF)
description: The trustedOrigins handler in src/lib/auth.ts dynamically appended the client-provided Origin and Host headers directly to the allowed origins list without validation, allowing any attacker website to bypass CSRF defenses on authentication and session endpoints.
root_cause: Dynamic reflection of unvalidated request headers into security trust decisions (OWASP A01 / Cloudflare WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md).
intended_behavior: Only pre-configured, strictly allowlisted origins (BETTER_AUTH_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, TRUSTED_ORIGINS) and verified local development origins in non-production environments must be accepted.

trace.description: Handles authentication requests via Better-Auth handler
Receives untrusted Origin header from client request
Pushes unverified origin into allowed array

evidence.description: origins.push(u.origin) executed on untrusted user header input

conditions: Attacker creates malicious cross-site page that submits requests with credentials to /api/auth endpoints

minimal_fix.summary: Enforce strict origin allowlist matching against env vars and restrict local network origins to development mode only.

source_changes.description: Replaced origin reflection with strict allowlist validation.

title: Missing Authentication on Database Seeding & User Enumeration Endpoints
description: The /api/seed-db and /api/seed endpoints allowed unauthenticated callers to dump existing user records and trigger destructive database resets via GET request (?force=true).
root_cause: Missing authentication and authorization checks on critical database administrative functions (CWE-306 / OWASP A01).
intended_behavior: Seeding endpoints must be hard-locked in production (403), require Sys Admin session authentication or explicit SEED_API_SECRET in development, never leak user emails, and require POST for state changes.

trace.description: Inspects ?force=true query parameter without verifying caller identity
Executes seedDatabase({ reset: true }) destructively clearing tables

evidence.description: Unauthenticated caller triggers seedDatabase({ reset: true })

minimal_fix.summary: Block route in production, require sys_admin auth in development, eliminate PII dump, and require POST for reset.

source_changes.description: Added authorizeSeeding guard enforcing production lockout and sys_admin auth.

title: Missing Authentication on Database Schema Migration Endpoints
description: The /api/push-db and /api/migrate-db endpoints allowed unauthenticated callers to execute Drizzle SQL migrations and exposed full database table inventories in responses.
root_cause: Missing authentication and authorization controls on schema migration endpoints (CWE-306 / OWASP A01).
intended_behavior: Database migrations must only be executable by authenticated Sys Admins or via verified MIGRATION_API_SECRET bearer token.

trace.description: Invokes Drizzle migrate() without checking authorization
Returns list of database tables and applied SQL migrations

evidence.description: migrate(db, { migrationsFolder }) called with no credentials

minimal_fix.summary: Enforce sys_admin session check or MIGRATION_API_SECRET token and mask internal errors in production.

source_changes.description: Added sys_admin and bearer token authentication check.

title: Authentication Rate Limiting Bypass via Client-Controlled X-Forwarded-For Header
description: The edge middleware extracted client IP addresses from untrusted client-supplied headers without prioritizing Cloudflare edge-authenticated cf-connecting-ip, allowing rate limiting evasion.
root_cause: Trusting client-controlled HTTP headers for identity and rate limiting keys (Cloudflare WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md).
intended_behavior: Prioritize Cloudflare cf-connecting-ip header, which cannot be forged by clients when proxied by Cloudflare.

trace.description: Supplies spoofable IP string to rate limiting bucket

evidence.description: req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') trusted before edge proxy headers

conditions: Attacker conducts credential stuffing and rotates X-Forwarded-For header values

minimal_fix.summary: Prioritize cf-connecting-ip before fallback headers and lock out seed routes in production.

title: Database Connection Error Message Disclosure on Unhealthy Status
description: The /api/health endpoint returned raw database driver exception messages to unauthenticated callers upon connection failures, leaking internal connection strings, hostnames, and ports.
root_cause: Unfiltered exception reflection in HTTP responses (OWASP A05 / CWE-209).
intended_behavior: Mask internal database errors in production environments while logging details server-side.

trace.description: Reflects raw error.message in JSON response

evidence.description: error: error instanceof Error ? error.message returned to caller

conditions: Database connection failure occurs while unauthenticated user requests /api/health

minimal_fix.summary: Mask internal errors in production with 'Database service unavailable'.
